sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: diagram-design is an agent skill that draws diagrams as a single self-contained HTML and SVG file. You ask your AI agent for an architecture diagram, flowchart, sequence, timeline or one of 52 types, and it writes one file you can open in a browser, styled to match your brand.
sixtySeconds.problem: Diagrams from AI tools often look generic or need a renderer like Mermaid. This skill gives your agent design rules and templates so it produces clean, static diagrams with no build step, and can pull your site's colours and fonts.
whoFor: Product people making quadrants and timelines
Writers adding diagrams to docs and posts
Users of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for polished, dependency-free diagrams from a plain-language request. Output is static HTML and SVG, so it suits docs and slides rather than live editing.
requirements: An Agent Skills host such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf or Amp

overview: Install the skill and ask your agent in plain words, such as 'make me an architecture diagram of my app: frontend, backend, database, Redis cache'. The agent picks the diagram type, states its plan and writes one .html file you can open by double-clicking.

There are 52 diagram types, each in minimal light, minimal dark and full-editorial variants, including architecture, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER data model and timeline. Output has no build step, JavaScript or external images.

An onboarding step reads your website to match its palette and fonts for every later diagram. The repository includes a gallery of every diagram, templates, an importer and a cookbook of recipes. Official builds come only from this repository.

troubleshooting.problem: Claude Desktop rejects the skill upload
troubleshooting.solution: Its upload limit is 200 files; build a bounded ZIP with python3 scripts/build-claude-skill-zip.py.
Standalone installs don't follow marketplaces; run npx skills update diagram-design, or enable auto-update for the Claude Code marketplace.
